intent.purpose: slideshow value frame: the established character after a treadmill walk
intent.scene_concept: the character takes a quick mirror selfie next to the treadmills after an evening walk, in a commercial gym
must_stay_true: the person is the character in the character sheet, recognisably the same as C1-C3
commercial gym cardio area with a row of treadmills
mirror selfie with her own phone, which has her sage-green case

appeal.relative_to_inspiration: at least as attractive as any organic inspiration or benchmark used with her; never plainer
appeal.face: strikingly pretty: clear grey-green eyes, a small upturned nose, full natural lips and a warm, slightly uneven smile that reads as charming
appeal.physique: aspirational fit hourglass: tight waist, full hips and chest, toned thighs, slim soft arms

subject.description: the character, slightly sweaty after a 30-minute incline walk
subject.action: taking a mirror selfie with her right hand, left hand holding a water bottle at her side
subject.pose: three-quarter turn toward the mirror, weight on the back leg, relaxed shoulders
subject.face_visibility: face visible beside the phone, the phone covers her chin only

identity.skin: warm golden tan with faint sports-bra tan lines, light freckles across the nose, visible pores, a small mole under the left eye
identity.hair: shoulder-length dark-blonde hair with darker natural roots, slightly frizzy, pulled into a claw clip with strands falling out
identity.face: soft oval face, grey-green eyes, straight brows a shade darker than her hair, small upturned nose, slightly uneven smile
identity.distinguishing_marks: the mole under the left eye; no tattoos

physique.proportions: realistic adult proportions: tight waist, full hips, toned thighs
physique.detail: slim soft arms with no visible muscle definition

items: dusty-blue fitted gym set: crop top and high-waisted leggings
wardrobe.fit_and_condition: sweat darkening the waistband and the centre of the top, leggings creased at the knees

environment.setting: cardio area of a commercial gym in the evening
foreground: a smudge on the mirror at chest height
background: a row of black treadmills with lit consoles, one with a towel over the handrail
grey carpet tiles with a worn path
a wall-mounted TV showing a blurred news channel
two other members walking far behind, small and soft
environment.clutter: a spray bottle and paper-towel roll on a ledge, a forgotten water bottle on a console
environment.time_of_day: evening, dark windows at the back

camera.device: iPhone 13, rear main camera pointed at the mirror
camera.position: phone at chest-to-chin height, toward the mirror

composition.crop: lower legs cut at the knee
composition.headroom: some ceiling and a light fixture visible

lighting.quality: even but flat, with small shadows under the chin
lighting.exposure: slightly bright on the ceiling panels

casts: faint blue from the consoles on the treadmills

imperfections: light indoor noise in the carpet

texture.skin: sweat sheen on the chest and forehead, freckles, pores, the mole under the left eye
texture.fabric: matte technical fabric with sweat marks
texture.surfaces: carpet tiles, matte black treadmill plastic, smudged mirror

motion.subject: still
motion.blur: background members slightly blurred by their movement

anatomy: the phone hand is her right hand in the reflection
the left hand holds the bottle with five fingers
one head, two arms, two legs
physics: treadmills stand on the floor in a straight row
the towel drapes over the handrail under gravity
geometry.reflections: the mirror shows her and the room reversed; the phone back with its case faces the mirror; screen text reads mirrored
geometry.perspective: mirror selfie perspective from chest height

phone.case: matte sage-green silicone phone case with a scuffed corner
phone.hold: right hand, case facing the mirror

typography.scene_text: treadmill console numbers too small and soft to read; TV text blurred

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding: real-looking treadmill maker logos and a water-bottle brand are fine; do not invent new readable words
brands: treadmill manufacturer logo on the consoles

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no second phone and no case other than the sage-green one
no muscular arms or visible biceps
no beauty filter or poreless skin
no correctly readable text in the mirror
